mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food (create_time, creator, is_deleted, update_time, updater, food_explain, food_img, food_name, food_price, remarks, business_id) VALUES (#{createTime}, #{creator}, #{isDeleted}, #{updateTime}, #{updater}, #{foodExplain}, #{foodImg}, #{foodName}, #{foodPrice}, #{remarks}, #{businessId})
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.creator, f.updater, f.is_deleted, f.food_name, f.food_explain, f.food_img, f.food_price, f.remarks, f.business_id, f.shelve_status, b.business_name FROM food f LEFT JOIN business b ON f.business_id = b.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 WHERE f.id = #{foodId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.shelve_status = 1
